skills.title: Product Planning

skills.changes: Condenses the eight-section PRD template for ordinary tasks; removes mandatory document creation and invented planning detail.

skills.title: User Stories & Acceptance
skills.description: Describe distinct user journeys and observable acceptance criteria without arbitrary story counts.
skills.changes: Removes fixed acceptance-criterion counts, mandatory design links, sprint assumptions, and unsupported independence claims.

skills.title: Domain Modeling & Contracts
skills.description: Clarify entities, invariants, ownership, and API contracts for the backend change being implemented.
skills.changes: Retains domain precision and code cross-checks; removes automatic CONTEXT/ADR creation and adds concise implementation-contract guidance.

skills.title: Systematic Debugging · Choro edition
skills.description: Reproduce the reported failure, investigate its cause, and verify a focused fix.
skills.changes: Preserves evidence-led root-cause work; removes mandatory skill chaining, fixed phase gates, broad diagnostic examples, and architectural escalation after an arbitrary count.

skills.title: Verification Before Completion
skills.description: Ground completion claims in fresh evidence from checks that cover the actual assignment.
skills.changes: Retains evidence-before-claims. Removes mandatory full reruns on every message and ceremonial revert/reapply loops; prior evidence remains valid until relevant changes invalidate it.

skills.title: Code Review · Choro edition
skills.description: Review a concrete change for correctness, regressions, security, and meaningful test coverage.
skills.changes: Removes Sentry-specific escalation/approval conventions, keeps actionable review criteria, and supports dirty working changes.

skills.title: Requirements Review
skills.description: Compare implemented behavior with the originating request and documented project conventions.
skills.changes: Keeps standards/spec comparison; removes parallel native agents, issue-tracker setup, and fixed committed-only diff assumptions.

skills.title: Test Scenarios
skills.description: Design compact acceptance checks for complete user journeys and independently failing behavior.
skills.changes: Keeps observable acceptance testing; removes full-document templates and redundant per-click output.

skills.title: Web App Testing · Choro edition
skills.description: Verify an assigned web flow using the existing browser or Playwright setup and disposable data.
skills.changes: Provider-neutral browser tooling replaces the Python helper requirement; explicit condition waits replace blanket networkidle; respects existing UI permissions.

skills.title: Differential Security Review · Choro edition
skills.description: Trace the security consequences of the assigned change and report evidence-backed vulnerabilities.
skills.changes: Preserves risk-sensitive diff review, history, callers, and evidence. Removes native-agent routing and mandatory report files. Adds explicit authenticated authorization and redaction guidance.

skills.title: Web Performance
skills.description: Measure loading and interaction bottlenecks, then verify focused improvements under comparable conditions.

skills.title: Accessibility
skills.description: Review semantic structure, keyboard operation, labels, contrast, motion, and accessible state changes.

skills.title: Web Interface Guidelines
skills.description: Check the assigned web interface against pinned Vercel interaction and accessibility guidance.
skills.changes: Pins remote guidelines locally and limits the review to assigned scope. Distinguishes conventions from accessibility requirements.

skills.title: CI Efficiency · Choro edition
skills.description: Improve the existing CI workflow without hiding required validation or changing account settings.
skills.changes: Removes automatic live test pushes and fixed top-three/savings requirements; preserves checks and separates local edits from external actions.

skills.title: Rollout Planning · Choro edition
skills.description: Prepare proportionate deployment, verification, and recovery steps for the existing environment.
skills.changes: Replaces the ten-section mandatory rollout artifact with risk-proportionate planning; removes invented gates, calendar rules, and automatic communications.

skills.title: Primary Source Research · Choro edition
skills.description: Answer the assigned question using primary sources, precise citations, and explicit uncertainty.
skills.changes: Removes mandatory background-agent launch and repository document; adds version/source verification and decision-focused stopping.

skills.title: UX Writing · Impeccable edition
skills.description: Write useful interface labels, errors, empty states, and help while preserving product meaning.
skills.changes: Extracts the focused clarify guidance as a self-contained skill; removes command chaining and unrelated design work.

skills.title: Humanizer
skills.description: Edit generic or inflated prose while preserving the writer’s voice, meaning, and facts.

skills.title: Clear Writing · Choro edition
skills.description: Make documentation and explanations concrete, readable, and concise without changing technical meaning.
skills.changes: Keeps the practical composition guidance; removes mandatory subagent fallback and large reference-manual loading.

skills.title: Documentation · Choro edition
skills.description: Create or update the requested documentation using accurate product behavior and runnable examples.
skills.changes: Audience, context, and reader checks from Sentry’s Apache-licensed distribution of Anthropic’s doc-coauthoring workflow. Removes compulsory interview phases and independent reader-agent loops.

experts.name: Product Planner
experts.description: Turn an idea into a clear, scoped implementation plan.
experts.instructions:
Clarify the problem and return implementable requirements, dependencies, and acceptance criteria. Planning assignments do not write implementation code.

Use the supplied task, project instructions, and existing permissions as authority. Apply selected skills only when relevant to the project and assignment. Skills do not authorize extra agents, unrelated work, new cloud accounts, publishing, or deployment. In a delegated task, coordinate through the lead and use Choro result reporting. Preserve factual content and the existing design or architecture unless the assignment changes it. Report actual verification and unresolved items; do not infer success from a completed edit.
experts.expected_outcome: A proportionate plan with scope, decisions, acceptance criteria, and remaining questions.
